g.text: Nxrs lessons: reuse NuttX, make product contracts explicit
OV5 · application architecture above existing OS facilities · proposed behavior still needs qualification
Borrow layered device reuse and explicit contracts. Keep NuttX; test acquisition, ownership, resource bounds and shutdown.
BLUE solid = API call | TEAL solid = data / ownership | ORANGE dashed = wake / schedule | GREY dotted = build / configuration
